purpose: Name-based migration guidance for the owner-approved merge of SUV/crossover into car. Does not rewrite datasets.

safe_consolidations.notes: SUVs, crossovers, and sedans share the canonical car detector label. Preserve source provenance during remapping.
Legacy short SUV labels use the same owner-approved consolidation.

numeric_yolo_class_id_policy.warning: YOLO class IDs are embedded in each weights file's names map. Never rewrite label IDs by assuming the 1.2.0 order.
numeric_yolo_class_id_policy.safe_approach: Validate the source names map, remap by class name, then export a new dataset version whose numeric IDs match schema 1.3.0.

seven_class_baseline_weights.notes: The seven-class baseline already uses car as its only passenger-car body label and remains a valid subset of the 10-class roster.

dry_run.behavior: Reports the current contract and optional numeric label counts without rewriting files.
